comparison.objective: Install a rack rail using spring prongs and screws; record drifts a splice plate into alignment and bolts it to a flange.
comparison.physical_skill: Both test alignment plus fastening; the candidate requires supporting a long articulated rail, simultaneous tab/prong engagement at one post, telescoping to another post while preserving retention, and handed rack-unit leveling. The record uses a drift pin to coerce two bolt holes into line before bolting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fully sprung prongs, same rack unit, self-support, bottom-hole screws, and reserved top holes empty; record requires both splice holes bolted and the drift pin returned.
comparison.reason: There is substantive shared alignment/bolting, but the central tested mechanisms differ: drift-assisted hole fit-up versus staged spring-latch installation across separated supports. Candidate force/damage limits are still missing and require measurement.
